svg.title: Startup and repeated pulsatile states
svg.desc: A newly implemented closed six-compartment circulation at80 beats per minute and systemic resistance17.86. Three pressures and both ventricular volumes are shown over15 seconds. Individual compartments change despite constant total volume.
